title: Freelancer UE 5.8 port (Space Simulator)
author: YourElectricityBill
selftext:
Hi. Some of tthe older folks might remember a game called [Freelancer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freelancer_(video_game)), so I always dreamed of a modern remaster for the game, and trying to recreate it on Unreal Engine 5.8. I have a certain experience with C++ and Blueprints, but due to sheer amount of work needed for this goal, I ultimately tried to employ AI in work, and I need to say, I am fairly impressed how great those tools have become.

The game will be free upon release. 

[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/sywPg6eFEM)

comments.author: ABigTongue
comments.body: Amazing work used to love that game!

replies.author: YourElectricityBill
replies.body: Some of them, but not all.

replies.author: Rabus
replies.body: nice! What did you use for the ai and non ai? own work / assets? (genuine question, i plan to start working on my own ai developed games and looking for pointers)

replies.author: YourElectricityBill
replies.body: Non AI - original FL assets, the planet, models, AI - game logic, scripts and recreating game mechanics. I am not planning to make it open source precisely due to using 3rd party assets. AI is not good at creating release-ready models still for example.

replies.author: Rabus
replies.body: did you build the assets or just buy them ?

replies.author: YourElectricityBill
replies.body: Buy, that's why not open-sourcing the project.
